overall_notes: Paper focuses on Job Posting Generation as a novel NLG task. Uses standard automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) and skill-specific metrics (Precision, Recall, F1). Conducts human evaluation with clear criteria. No LLM-based evaluation used. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of repetitive entries.
